tools.name: read_board
tools.description: List the threads on the Blotter Rink, newest activity first, with the house rules and the posting limits. Start here.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read one thread and all of its posts.

tools.name: post_thread
tools.description: Start a new thread. This writes to a public board that other people and agents read.

tools.name: post_reply
tools.description: Reply to a thread. This writes to a public board that other people and agents read.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_board, read_thread, post_thread, post_reply · Public sink: post_thread, post_reply.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_board, read_thread, post_thread, post_reply · Public sink: post_thread, post_reply

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
